profile.summary: World's largest maker of motorcycles and scooters by volume for 25 years (64.69 lakh units in FY26). Brands: Splendor, HF Deluxe, Passion (100-110cc), Glamour, Super Splendor, Xtreme 125R (125cc), Xtreme 160R/250R, Xpulse, Karizma, Mavrick and the Harley-Davidson X440 (premium), Destini, Xoom, Pleasure+ (scooters), VIDA (electric scooters). Sells in 53 countries; 14,000+ customer touchpoints; 130 mn two-wheelers sold since 1984.
profile.plantsAndCapacity: Six plants in India (Dharuhera 1984, Gurugram 1997, Haridwar 2008, Neemrana 2014, Halol 2016, Chittoor/Tirupati 2020) plus Colombia (2015) and Bangladesh; annual capacity ~8.63 mn units (FY26). R&D: Centre for Innovation and Technology, Jaipur (2016) and Tech Center Germany (2019).
profile.subsidiaries: HMC MM Auto (India), HMCL Americas, HMCL Netherlands, HMCL Colombia, HMCL Niloy Bangladesh, HMCL Tech Center Germany. Associates (equity-accounted): Hero FinCorp 40.45%, Ather Energy 30.07% at Mar-26 (~32% after Aug-26 purchases), Euler Motors 34.12%.

reporting.segments: One reportable segment (automotive). Volumes by type are SIAM data; the company discloses EV revenue/investment, parts revenue and export volume/revenue on calls.
reporting.modelBasis: Screener consolidated. Consolidated profit includes the share of profit/loss of associates (Hero FinCorp, Ather, Euler: +Rs385 cr in FY26 incl. a ~Rs722 cr one-time dilution gain in Q1FY26; -Rs161 cr in FY25; -Rs120 cr in FY24; -Rs44 cr in Q1FY27). Our forecasts exclude it; the stakes are valued separately.
reporting.src: AR FY26 consolidated P&L and note 9A; Q1FY26/Q1FY27 results

q1fy27.notes: Revenue +36% on volume +23%, mix +8% (scooters, EV, premium, exports, parts) and price. West Asia conflict lifted steel, aluminium, precious metals, freight and gas costs: gross margin -300 bp QoQ; other expenses cut 14% QoQ. EV loss per unit down from ~Rs50,000 to ~Rs40,000; some VIDA models gross-margin positive. Consolidated PAT -17% because Q1FY26 carried the Rs722 cr dilution gain (Ather IPO and a private placement).

quarterlyKpis.marginDrivers: Flat volumes (pre-GST lull); EV drag 2.4 pts; consolidated PAT boosted by the Rs722 cr associate dilution gain.
GST cut from 22-Sep-2025 and festive demand; record 15.0% margin on operating leverage; ICE margin 17.7%.
Festive retail ~1 mn on VAHAN; Oct-25 VAHAN share 31.6%; Rs119 cr labour-code exceptional.
Record revenue; commodity inflation from March (Rs2,100/unit cost vs Rs2,000/unit price); EV investment Rs220 cr.
Gross margin -300 bp QoQ on ~4.5% commodity inflation (West Asia); other expenses -14% QoQ; ICE margin 15.9%; VIDA loss Rs230 cr, PLI Rs48 cr.

guidance: High single digit (May-26), raised to 'approaching double digit' (Aug-26); positive in H2 despite the post-GST base
Medium-term 14-16% retained; not achievable in the short term because of transitory commodity inflation; focus on absolute EBITDA
Marginal uptick in input costs, to be offset by mix, discretionary-spend cuts and LEAP savings; marginal price rise in July
~4.5% blended ICE price increase since end-Feb 2026; EV early double digits; tactical HF Deluxe price cut in some states
15k/month (Mar-26) to ~30k/month (Aug-26) to ~45k/month by Q4FY27; PLI on 100% of the range by Dec-26; EBITDA breakeven ambition 'by the end of the year'
Rs1,500 cr incl. GPC 2.0 parts centre (Rs750 cr, Tirupati, commissioning by end-2027), scooter/Splendor/EV capacity, Neemrana premium line
Aim for the 40%+ annual growth of the last two years; new markets (Germany, Ecuador, VIDA in Nepal)
Growth ~25%+ in Q1FY27 and July; ~50% of demand still served by grey market
Not in FY27; platforms (Ubex urban, VXZ with Zero Motorcycles) from FY28

macro.gst: GST on two-wheelers up to 350cc cut from 28% to 18% from 22-Sep-2025 (above 350cc moved to 40%); Hero passed on the full benefit: HF Deluxe up to Rs5,805, Splendor+ Rs6,820, Glamour X Rs7,813, Xtreme 160R Rs10,985, Karizma Rs15,743. Festive 2025 retail ~1 mn on VAHAN, Oct-25 share 31.6% (+370 bp). Src: https://www.autocarindia.com/bike-news/hero-bike-prices-drop-by-up-to-rs-15743-with-new-gst-rates-437142 (Sep-2025); Q2FY26 call (14-Nov-2025).
macro.rareEarth: China put rare-earth magnets under export licensing from 4-Apr-2025; Bajaj Chetak output fell 47% in Jul-25 and Ather supplies were hit, while Hero said it was covered for Q2FY26 and supplies normalised; VIDA output rose 146% in Jul-25 and its VAHAN share jumped to 12.6% in Aug-25. Src: Q1FY26 call (Aug-2025); https://www.autocarpro.in/analysis-report/bajaj-chetak-production-plunges-by-47-in-july-due-to-shortage-of-rare-earth-magnets-128069.
macro.monsoon2026: IMD forecast 92% of LPA (13-Apr-2026), cut to 90% on El Nino (29-May-2026); season ended ~13% short (87% of LPA; 758.5 mm vs 865 mm to 29-Sep), weakest since 2015, withdrawal from 19-Sep. Src: https://mausam.imd.gov.in/Forecast/marquee_data/Salient_Features_SW_MONSOON%20_2026_30_sep.pdf; https://www.downtoearth.org.in/climate-change/monsoon-2026-report-card-rainfall-12-less-than-normal-across-india-with-60-less-rain-in-meghalaya-and-24-less-in-the-south
macro.commodities: West Asia conflict from ~Mar-2026 lifted aluminium (near record), steel, rubber, plastics, gas and freight; Hero's BOM inflation 'high single digit' (May-26); Q4FY26 cost +Rs2,100/unit vs price +Rs2,000; Q1FY27 net commodity inflation ~4.5%. INR ~95/USD in Aug-2026 (Emkay).
macro.evPolicy: PLI-Auto: benefit ~13% of EV revenue on certified models (60% of VIDA range in Q1FY27, 100% by Dec-26). Delhi proposed EV policy from FY28 (Q1FY27 call).

Became the world's largest two-wheeler maker
Royalty-free but had to build own R&D (CIT Jaipur 2016, TCG Germany 2019)
Ather investments (first 2016; Rs140 cr Dec-23; Rs124 cr Jun-24)
Late entry to e-scooters; VAHAN units 18,783 (FY24), 50,800 (FY25), 1,49,341 (FY26)

CEO Niranjan Gupta resigned (effective 30-Apr-2025); Vikram Kasbekar acting CEO; Harshavardhan Chitale CEO from 5-Jan-2026
GST cut to 18%; FY26 volumes +9.6% to 64.69 lakh, record profit
Ather warrants (Rs960 cr) and block purchase (Rs1,758 cr)
Rs2,000 cr of cash moved into Ather in FY27, Rs720 cr more on conversion

governance.investigations: Income-tax search (2022) led to disallowed expenses: demand Rs178 cr (FY25 AR), Rs27 cr now under appeal at ITAT, no provision. DRI customs case (foreign currency carried abroad) and ED money-laundering case against Dr. Pawan Munjal (attachment Rs24.95 cr, 2023): Delhi High Court stayed DRI proceedings (Nov-2023) and ED proceedings against him (17-Nov-2023); the company says some investigations concluded favourably and it sees no impact on its accounts (AR FY26).
